variants.label: two_block_knock + key_exfil
variants.stealth_note: Very high - fires only on a 2^-64 two-word input sequence; never accidental.
variants.effect_note: Full secret-key disclosure (device cloning / offline decrypt of all traffic).

variants.label: counter_based + output_corruption
variants.stealth_note: Medium - invisible until it fires, but activation is guaranteed after a fixed op count and needs a wide counter.
variants.effect_note: Predictable ciphertext corruption (silent data-integrity failure after threshold).

variants.label: time_bomb + bypass
variants.stealth_note: Low - a free-running counter fires on a fixed schedule regardless of input (DoS-like, most detectable).
variants.effect_note: Encryption bypass - output forced to a constant, nullifying confidentiality of all later traffic.
